chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Whenever a person conceals a thing in his heart it manifests itself through unintentional words from his tongue and (in) the expressions of his face.

key_terms.أَضْمَرَ: to conceal or harbor in the heart

ai.seo_question: How do hidden thoughts manifest in a person's behavior and appearance?
ai.summary: In this famous hadith from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elucidates the concept of 'khafiyah' (hiddenness) versus 'zahiriyyah' (manifestation), asserting that the soul's true state cannot remain concealed from the body's subtle signs. This teaching is foundational in Shia spiritual psychology, linking inner sincerity (ikhlas) to external demeanor, and is often cited in tafsir and hadith commentaries to explain how divine knowledge perceives the heart through its physical vessels. The reference to 'flattāt' (slips of the tongue) and 'safahāt' (pages of the face) highlights the involuntary nature of these manifestations, serving as a mirror for self-reflection (muhasabah).
